integrity: Analytic finite-graph and entropy proof; included small-example checker is not a substitute for proof. No independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite directed multigraphs with all vertices on cycles, unrestricted unit-speed edge switching and entire trajectories. Strong-backward ergodicity of a state marginal differs from ergodicity of a chosen lift. Entropy is the maximum over stationary trajectory lifts. Equivalence in uninspected graph-flow literature cannot be excluded.
title: Stationary-circulation, coarse-ergodicity and entropy laws for switching graph flows
